newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish 1996 grain harvest seen unchanged from 1995.
newsitem.headline: Danish 1996 grain harvest seen unchanged from 1995.

text.p: Denmark's 1996 grain harvest is expected to total 9.18 million tonnes, virtually unchanged from 1995's 9.15 million, the Danish Agricultural Advisory Centre said on Tuesday in its latest harvest forecast.
It said the total grain area under cultivation increased by 100,000 hectares over the previous year to 1.55 million hectares, but the average yield per hectare was six percent lower, at 5.92 tonnes.
It forecast winter barley and winter rye down on last year's harvest, winter wheat, spring wheat and oats little changed and spring barley up.
Final figures are expected to be published by the National Statistics office in November.
